name: PC-1234
caveats: An internal handle identifies a label rather than a legal identity; DTEX also reports a prior impersonator using it to push malware.
Presented names and account labels are source-reported personas or handles; legal identity requires source evidence.

value.label: PC-1234
value.reported_role: single administrator of the internal payment-server data

sources.locator: Paragraph beginning Data from the internal North Korean payment server
sources.quote: Data from the internal North Korean payment server, which was first published by ZachXBT in April, is controlled by “PC-1234,” a single administrator that DTEX has been tracking for a while. The wallet and its cluster of activity remains active, Barnhart said.

notes: Edited press relay of a DTEX/Barnhart assessment; it is corroborative source diversity, not independent technical evidence. Single administrator does not resolve civil identity or natural-person count, and reported wallet activity does not establish present control at the review cutoff.

identity_boundary: PC-1234 is a DTEX-reported historical administrator label on an internal DPRK payment server; it remains a role label separate from any legal identity and from the unknown actor who reportedly impersonated it to distribute malware.
